description: This Java source file is a configuration class for setting up OpenAPI (Swagger) documentation in a Spring Boot application. It defines beans for a ForwardedHeaderFilter and an OpenAPI instance with a relative server URL based on the application's context path.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up OpenAPI and header forwarding in Spring Boot.

methods.name: forwardedHeaderFilter
methods.description: Creates and registers a ForwardedHeaderFilter bean to handle X-Forwarded-* headers, ensuring correct URL scheme and host information when behind proxies.

methods.name: applicationOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and registers an OpenAPI bean with the server URL set as a relative path based on the servlet context path, enabling proper Swagger UI behavior with correct scheme and host.
